title: Scout's Honor Vacation Rental
meta_description: Scout's Honor is a 2.00 bedroom, 3.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: DescriptionSCOUT’S HONORRosemary Beach CommunityScout Lane, Rosemary Beach, FL 32461Home Highlights2 bedrooms plus a hallway bunk area (see “Room Details” tab for configurations)3 bathrooms1,560 sq. ft. interior + 475 sq. ft. outdoor spaceSleeps up to 6 guestsKing master suite with private bath and covered balcony spanning the homeKing guest room with Jack-and-Jill bath shared with the hallway bunk areaSpacious shaded porches and balconies overlooking Kingsbridge ParkFirst-floor bathroom with exterior access—perfect for rinsing off after the beachFull-size stackable washer & dryerTwo-vehicle driveway + 1-car overflow (1 parking pass issued)Two 26" adult bikes included seasonally (not available Dec–Feb; additional rentals on request)As one of the largest two-bedroom homes in Rosemary Beach, Scout’s Honor is perfect for one or two families seeking a luxurious beach getaway. The whitewashed décor, beadboard details, and abundant natural light create a cozy yet crisp coastal atmosphere. With more than 2,000 sq. ft. of indoor and outdoor living space—including double covered porches overlooking Kingsbridge Park—you’ll find the ideal mix of relaxation and recreation. Take in the tranquil setting from your porch, stroll to the nearby Cabana pool, or access the beach via Rosemary’s wooden pedestrian paths.Two king bedrooms and cleverly tucked hallway bunks make this home both stylish and family-friendly.Community AmenitiesRosemary Beach offers a quintessential coastal experience with luxury, charm, and convenience at every turn:Four community pools (some heated seasonally)Private community beach accessRosemary Town Square with boutique shopping and diningPlaygrounds, parks, and green spacesOutdoor amphitheaterPedestrian-friendly paths and lush landscapingFitness center and racquet club (additional fee)Note: Golf carts are prohibited in the Rosemary Beach community.ParkingScout’s Honor provides designated parking for two vehicles in the driveway + 1-car overflow. One parking pass is issued per HOA rules. On-street parking is limited and enforced; vehicles must be in marked spaces with valid permits. 30A Cottages is not liable for fines or towing.Reservation & Booking PoliciesThe 30A Cottages & Concierge Vacation Rental Agreement governs cancellations, overriding third-party sites.No smoking.Pets not allowed (service animals only; prior notification and documentation required).Published rates do not include taxes/fees.50% due at booking; balance due 60 days before arrival (or in full if booking within 60 days).5% cancellation fee applies; initial 50% fully refundable if canceled >60 days before arrival.Optional travel insurance available (must be purchased before final payment).Check-in: 4:00 PM CST | Check-out: 10:00 AM CSTRenters must be 25 years old and present for the entire stay; no key issued to anyone under 25.
rooms_guidance: 2nd Floor King Master Bedroom: King - Large private balcony overlooking small park and garden
2nd Floor King Guest Bedroom: King - Bathroom accessible from Guest Master and Bunk Area
2nd Floor Bonus Bunk Area: Bunk Beds (2 Twins) - Located on the landing at the top of the stairs
